Cinema optical rack-focus across three depth planes

I wanted to know if one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas could composite three overlapping drawable HTML planes at separate depths with variable-aperture golden-angle disc bokeh and cinema focus breathing. Tap any plane directly on the canvas, press Tab to move focus into a control, or use the focus buttons and aperture slider below.

Show the code three drawable depth planes, spring optics, 24-tap disc bokeh shader, WebGL pipeline and hit-box sync
  1. Three staggered drawable planes in one canvas. Far settings sheet (#rf-bg), midground editable workspace card (#rf-mid) and foreground inspector toast (#rf-fg) sit inside one <canvas content="drawable" layoutsubtree>.
  2. Aperture Circle of Confusion, deterministic tMs spring and plane layout. Computes normalized defocus across f/1.4 to f/11, evaluates the damped spring at exact timestamps and keeps primary buttons uncovered on 412 px phones.
  3. 24-tap golden-angle Poisson disc bokeh shader. Uses a single sharp tap when uBlurPx < 0.25 and switches to linear-light 24-tap Vogel disc accumulation with specular bloom and premultiplied alpha feathering when out of focus.
  4. Single-context WebGL 2 compositing. Calls stage.begin() before uploading dirty planes inside paint with UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL = true, draws back-to-front directly to the default framebuffer and unbinds the VAO.
  5. Focus-breathing hit-box calibration. Syncs updateElementGeometry() with geometryUnit(), the 1 + 0.015 * coC breathing scale and dataset.hitTick so every control on all three planes stays clickable.
  6. Five-argument 2D and plain-HTML fallbacks. Draws the three depth planes with five-argument drawElementImage() without WebGL 2, or moves them into #plain-host on context loss.

How it works

I placed three separate drawable sections inside one <canvas id="rf-canvas" content="drawable" layoutsubtree> backed by one ElementGL WebGL 2 context. When you tap a plane, press Tab into one of its controls or pick a focal preset, a deterministic tMs damped-spring solver moves focusDepth smoothly between 0.0 (Far), 0.5 (Mid) and 1.0 (Near).

Inside the paint event listener, state.hasPainted flips to true, stage.begin() sets the viewport and backing store before any upload, and only dirty planes upload via gl.texElementSubImage2D() with gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL set to true and trilinear mipmaps generated via gl.generateMipmap(). Each frame draws directly to the default framebuffer (null) with zero offscreen FBO passes:

  1. Studio optical backdrop: draws a dark radial vignette with a subtle focus ring tied to uFocusDepth.
  2. Crisp active plane: when a plane's Circle of Confusion blur radius drops below 0.25 CSS px, FOCUS_FRAG samples LOD 0 with one unpadded texture tap so typography and inputs stay razor sharp.
  3. 24-tap golden-angle disc bokeh: defocused planes expand their quad by 26 CSS px and sample 24 golden-angle Vogel disc offsets at a mipmap LOD scaled to the Circle of Confusion radius in linear light, so bright pills, indicator LEDs and card corners feather smoothly into circular bokeh discs weighted by f/1.4 to f/11 without repeated text ghosts.

Out-of-focus planes also breathe outward by 1 + 0.015 * coC around their centres. syncPlaneGeometry() multiplies geometryUnit() by that same breathing matrix for each plane, writes canvas.updateElementGeometry() and toggles dataset.hitTick so clicks and text selection hit the right control across all three overlapping planes.

Findings

Measured in headless Google Chrome 160.0.8188.0 Canary (2026-11-27) at 412x915 (DPR 2.625) and 1040x900 (DPR 1). Real Chrome 159 on Android and npm run check:jank stay not verified.

  • Three live depth planes upload cleanly on one WebGL 2 context: Live check 1 uploaded all three staggered drawable planes through ElementGL (578×342, 500×276 and 394×169 texels at 2.625 DPR) with gl.getError() === 0. At 412 px wide, the main canvas holds 948×1036 px (0.98 MP, 7.86 MB live, 8.12 MB after checks), 0 lost contexts, 0 open snapshots and 0 unasked readbacks.
  • Mipmapped 24-tap golden-angle bokeh stops letter ghosts: Sampling LOD 0 on 1 px button text across a 22 CSS px blur radius initially left 24 faint ghost copies of the letters. Generating trilinear mipmaps after each upload and sampling textureLod() with per-pixel interleaved gradient noise rotation turned sharp typography into smooth optical blur while preserving circular bokeh discs on bright LEDs and chips.
  • Aperture f/1.4 vs f/11 and Far vs Near change measured edge sharpness: On isolated white step targets, the active plane held edge contrast at 248. Racking from Focus Far to Focus Near at f/1.4 dropped far-plane edge contrast from 248 to 14 and lifted 10 px outside bokeh spill to 189, while stopping down to f/11 restored far edge contrast to 231 with spill down to 7.
  • Hit testing tracks focus breathing across all three planes: Applying geometryUnit() and updateElementGeometry() with the 1 + 0.015 * coC breathing matrix kept controls on #rf-bg, #rf-mid (including the editable slate <input>) and #rf-fg clickable in both Focus Far and Focus Near. Real CDP clicks toggled HDR Highlights, incremented CUE 01 to CUE 02, typed into #rf-slate-input and triggered APPLIED #1 while selectstart stayed blocked on plane labels.
  • Reduced motion, 2D and plain-HTML fallbacks work at 412 px: Emulating prefers-reduced-motion: reduce checked Reduced motion, kept Cycle rack paused and snapped Focus Near in one frame. Deleting texElementSubImage2D ran the 5-argument drawElementImage() depth stack (61.8% fixture ink, 3.92 MB), synthetic webglcontextlost and webglcontextrestored recovered cleanly, and deleting drawElementImage moved all three planes into #plain-host at scrollWidth === 412 with zero CLS.
  • Not verified yet: real Android Chrome 159 touch scrolling and GPU frame rate, plus npm run check:jank -- /rack-focus/ and the build-time learn.js reduced-motion banner once npm run build indexes page.json.
